problem_statement: When a TCP peer closes its connection, its closing FIN|ACK segment may also acknowledge the last data the other side had sent. In that case the TCP stack must both advance its send-side sequence number to account for the acknowledged data and handle the received FIN. When the FIN handling was done in a separate early-exit path, the acknowledgement of the outstanding data was not fully applied, so the sequence number in the stack's own FIN|ACK reply was incorrect. The stack must produce a FIN|ACK reply whose sequence and acknowledgement numbers are correct, and then move to the final state.
twister_command: scripts/twister -p native_sim/native/64 -T tests/net/tcp -s tests/net/tcp/net.tcp.simple -s net.tcp.simple -O twister-out --no-clean -W
